statement.text: We let $Q_d$ denote the $d$-dimensional cube graph. A map $\phi: E(Q_d) \rightarrow \{0,1\}$ is called edge-antipodal if $\phi(e) \neq \phi(e')$ whenever $e,e'$ are antipodal edges. Conjecture If $d \ge 2$ and $\phi: E(Q_d) \rightarrow \{0,1\}$ is edge-antipodal, then there exist a pair of antipodal vertices $v,v' \in V(Q_d)$ which are joined by a monochromatic path.

title: Edge-antipodal colorings of cubes
